messages.content: Can you help me with a few tasks for my colleague alice? First, please find her contact card to check if she is available on 2024-11-15. I also need you to look up the gate board for flight CA1234 and archive those specific flight details for her via a high-priority email. After that, please publish a 60-minute slot ticket, using slot_999, for her in the app. Finally, I need to book Conference Room A, which has a capacity of 10, for a meeting with two people on 2024-11-15 starting at 14:00 and ending at 15:00.
